My Story

I'm a 20-year-old cinematographer, videographer, and FAA Part 107 licensed drone pilot based in Tampa Bay. I grew up obsessed with cars and motorsports — it's genuinely all I think about.

At a wrap shop event, I met someone doing automotive videography for a living. One conversation later, I was completely hooked. Before EP Films I spent years editing for YouTube channels with 500K+ subscribers. That's where I learned what actually makes people stop scrolling — and I bring that into every single shoot.

I built a custom camera rig on my Mazdaspeed3 so I could get shots no one else could. A shoot with me feels less like hiring a videographer and more like a fun day out with someone who loves cars as much as you do. Snacks on me.
